S No  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  CRLA No. 585 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
There is no representation for the appellant.
2. Mr. K.S. Bora, Deputy Advocate General with Mr. R.P. Kandpal, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. This criminal appeal has been filed against conviction, through legal aid counsel.

By the impugned judgment dated 31.08.2024 passed by learned Special Judge, (POCSO), Dehradun in Special Sessions Trial No. 39 of 2022, appellant has been convicted for offence punishment under Section 363, 376 IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to 20 years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.10,000/-.
Challenging his conviction appellant has filed this appeal.
4. As per office report, the appeal is within time.
Let Trial Court Record be summoned.
Objection, if any, to the bail application be filed in the meantime.

9. Exemption Application (IA No. 1 of 2024) stands disposed of.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 07.10.2024 Navin CRLA/585/2024 on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43075050/
